Hey, I'm Stefan!

Website Developer · 3 Years Experience · Tuburan, Cebu, PH

I build fast, responsive websites for small businesses, startups, and agencies — from simple landing pages to full WordPress, Shopify, and WooCommerce stores. I care about clean code and clear communication, and I like turning a rough idea into something a client is proud to show off. Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how Stefan ("I", "me") collects, uses, and protects information when you visit this website or use the contact form. By using this site, you agree to the practices described below.

Information I collect

When you submit the contact form, I collect the information you provide directly, which may include:

  • Your full name
  • Your email address
  • The subject and content of your message

I do not knowingly collect sensitive personal information, payment details, or information from anyone under the age of 18 through this site.

How I use your information

Information submitted through the contact form is used only to:

  • Respond to your inquiry or project request
  • Follow up about a potential or ongoing project
  • Keep basic records of client communication

I do not use your information for advertising, and I do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

Cookies and analytics

This site may use basic, privacy-friendly analytics to understand general traffic patterns (such as which pages are visited). This data is aggregated and is not used to personally identify you. No advertising cookies or third-party trackers are used.

Data sharing

Your information is not shared with third parties, except where required by law or where necessary to deliver a service you've specifically requested (for example, a shared project tool you ask me to use to collaborate).

Data retention

Contact form submissions are kept only as long as needed to respond to your inquiry or maintain a record of an ongoing working relationship, after which they may be deleted.

Your rights

You can request to see, correct, or delete any personal information I hold about you at any time by emailing me directly using the contact details below. I will respond to reasonable requests within a reasonable timeframe.

Security

I take reasonable precautions to protect the information you share, but no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and I can't guarantee absolute security.

Changes to this policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated occasionally to reflect changes in practices. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "last updated" date.

Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, reach out at stefan.springhive@gmail.com or 0910 671 6706, based in Tuburan, Cebu, PH.
